editorial.evidence: 16 November 2026: read all 44 captured sections of the real-time call assistant source and authored a teach-mode rewrite from scratch. The overview, main guide, deep dive and cheat sheet repeat the Full Design's mechanisms, so each mechanism is taught once in the place that fits (three-clock split in step 1, budget arithmetic with the explicit 2,000 ms sum in step 4, per-lane figures inside the snapshot, live-lane and post-call dives) and the shorter versions are mapped as consolidated. The brief uses the source's own Sara/Acme trace as the example and defines CRM, ASR, diarization, PII, VAD and p95 before use. Every substantive table (14 of 18; the old navigation table is consolidated, the main NFR table is merged into the fuller constraints table, and the follow-up table became eight reveals) and all 8 diagrams in both variants are kept beside their explanation. Old 'section N' pointers were removed from table cells and replaced with links to the new anchors. Three changed-constraint questions (unknown inbound caller, mid-call redaction outage, auto-applied stage) are labelled as authored additions; the consent-law example in the privacy dive comes from the source's own references. No RAG-case material was imported beyond the voice project's retrieval step the source itself describes.
